Area.evidence_source: Their future lives are in the balance, their uncertain talk does not rule out the possibility that some future event will push them to take their lives, or that recreational drug use will shift to habit and then necessity, or that past traumas or sense of abandonment will resurface and swallow their vitality. (Risk) --- For Simon, who had carried a gun around for a year, contemplating suicide, the crisis and its resolution were still of great significance but his family ties made him realise he had a will to live. (Recovery) --- I have been able to recognise points where I know that I'm going to have to pick up the phone and talk to somebody, other than just the Samaritans, someone that I would want to help.... I feel I have more control over myself now than I did before, yeah. Because I've woken up to responsibility, I've woken up to the fact that I know the answer's not in the bottom of a glass, I've woken up to the fact that not everybody out there hates me, not every phone call I make for a job is going to be a no, not every person I speak to is going to think of me as a bit of muck. (Recovery)
